description: This file is an ARM assembly source implementing a quantized depthwise convolution microkernel for 8x9 tiles using NEON instructions, specific to the PyTorch QNNPACK library.

methods.name: pytorch_q8dwconv_ukernel_up8x9__aarch32_neon
methods.description: Assembly implementation of a depthwise convolution kernel optimized for ARM aarch32 NEON. It performs quantized 8x9 convolution operations with various parameter loads and vectorized computations.
